title: IM2A 接入配置
description: 连接 IM2A Harness Bus。凭证只保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录，不会写入连接器或云端。
description_en: Connect to the IM2A Harness Bus. Credentials are stored locally under ~/.workbuddy and never written into the connector or cloud.

fields.label: im2a-mcp 可执行文件
fields.description: IM2A MCP stdio 可执行文件的绝对路径，或 PATH 中的 im2a-mcp。
fields.description_en: Absolute path to the IM2A MCP stdio executable, or im2a-mcp on PATH.

fields.label: IM2A Gateway 地址
fields.description: 本地或受控网络中的 IM2A gateway 地址。
fields.description_en: IM2A gateway address on localhost or a controlled network.

fields.label: IM2A Gateway Token
fields.placeholder: 由 IM2A gateway 管理员提供
fields.description: Bearer token；只保存在本机，不进入连接器包或日志。
fields.description_en: Bearer token. Stored locally only; never placed in the connector package or logs.
